programme.title: Every Monster i Found in 2024
programme.desc: A recap of all the rare aquatic creatures from abandoned ponds, sewers, pools, pet stores Bobby discovered and rescued in 2024!

programme.title: I Bought The Deadliest Insects (to keep as pets)
programme.desc: Bobby buys venomous insects and rare species to overcome his fear, encountering black widows, tarantulas, centipedes, and more, culminating in a room full of deadly pets.

programme.title: I Bought the World's SCARIEST Aquarium Fish!
programme.desc: Bobby brings you on an exciting journey of acquiring vampire fish with gnarly teeth from a local pet store and adding them to the aquarium, along with updates on other pet fish.

programme.title: I Found a MONSTER Living in My Pond!
programme.desc: Bobby drains his mystery pond to uncover and relocate various fish, including a massive catfish placed by a friend, while encountering snakes and other unique aquatic creatures.

programme.title: I Finally Caught the Sewer Monster!
programme.desc: Bobby and friends explore Walmart sewers, catching and saving different fish species with nets and traps, discussing unique fish and the flooded area.

programme.title: I Saved Animals From a Foreign Food Market!
programme.desc: Bobby and team enter a grocery store selling live animals, exposing disturbing conditions while rescuing a turtle and several live eels.

programme.title: I Found an Alien in My Pond!
programme.desc: Bobby drains his mystery pond filled with rare and exotic fish collected during a mental health break, including stingrays, an eel-like amphibian, and a rare frog fish.

programme.title: I Saved Fish TRAPPED in a Flooded Sewer!
programme.desc: Bobby leads a rescue mission in South Florida to save fish trapped in sewers before a hurricane, featuring various fish like albino plecos, catfish, and more.

programme.title: I Caught the Monster Attacking My Fish!
programme.desc: Bobby rescues fish from his pond after discovering a 4-foot ripsaw catfish attacking them. Rehousing includes freshwater sharks, sturgeons, and exotic catfish.

programme.title: Saving Monster Fish Living in Abandoned Pond!
programme.desc: Bobby rescues neglected fish and stray kittens from an abandoned pond, then relocates them to his home.

programme.title: I Found Creatures Living in Mud Holes!
programme.desc: Bobby and Helen exploring muddy waters and mysterious holes to find exotic fish and creatures, culminating in a competitive fish trap challenge between the two of them

programme.title: I Survived 24 Hours in an Alligator Infested Sewer!
programme.desc: Bobby spends 24 hours in a sewer aiming to catch fish but encounters various dangers including a persistent alligator, culminating in an unexpected gator entrapment.

programme.title: I Found a Monster Living in a Green Slime Pond...
programme.desc: Bobby and team find various hidden aquatic creatures, including blue crawfish and African cichlids, while exploring green slime ponds.

programme.title: I Found a Hidden Tunnel FILLED with Rare Fish!
programme.desc: Returning to a fish-filled tunnel, Bobby undertakes a 24-hour trapping challenge, catching various fish, crawfish, and a mysterious giant shrimp-like creature.

programme.title: I Found Mysterious Fish Living in an Abandoned Pond...
programme.desc: Bobby drains a pond full of mystery fish, finding unexpected goldfish, turtles, eels, and even an iridescent shark, relocating them to new habitats.

programme.title: I Found Live Animals in a Pet Store Dumpster!
programme.desc: Bobby explores pet store dumpsters to find live animals like fish, turtles, snakes, frogs, and lobsters, rescuing them and planning to provide them with better homes.

programme.title: I Found a Pond Infested with Sharks!
programme.desc: Bobby and team rescue rare fish from a pond, relocating koi, catfish, and sharks to new homes before the pond is destroyed.

programme.title: I Found Wild Axolotls in a Tiny Creek!
programme.desc: Bobby embarks on an exciting journey to the Florida Everglades to catch a wild axolotl, setting up a tank, and eventually finding success after hours of netting.

programme.title: My Favorite Fish Died...
programme.desc: Bobby and crew discovered the tragic deaths of Sweet Cheeks, a phantom Redtail catfish, and a koi fish in various ponds at his property.

programme.title: I Bought a PREHISTORIC Pond Monster!
programme.desc: Bobby buys rare sturgeons, a frog, and a deformed catfish from the Pond Doctors and faces challenges with predatory fish in his pond.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Who Will Save the Columbia River's Salmon? | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 829 - 12 - 829
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with Donella Miller and Doug Hatch of the Columbia River Inter-Tribal Fish Commission (CRITFC), Brody Henderson, Janis Putelis, Seth Morris, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: The Six Sovereigns restoration initiative of the Columbia River basin; having a holistic philosophy and viewing fish as a forever fixture; salmon runs; steelhead reconditioning; chinook recovery; sockeye and coho reintroduction; lamprey restoration; the sea lion crisis; and more. Feel free to donate to the recovery effort here: https://critfc.org/donate/

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Clovis First, Saving The Great Lakes, and LA's Ginormous Wildlife Crossing | The News Show Ep. 873 - 12 - 873
programme.desc: Steven Rinella, Brian Lynn of the Sportsmen's Alliance, and the MeatEater crew discuss: Washington's crooked Game Commission; Idaho hunting tech bans; the biggest and most hated wildlife crossing in the world; a plan to save Great Lakes whitefish; Clovis-first; and more. Donate to MeatEater's Land Access Initiatve and Save Tuckertown! here: https://www.themeateater.com/conservation/public-lands-and-waters/we-need-your-help-to-save-the-tuckertown-gamelands

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Dogs That Hunt Humans with Doug Roller | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 854 - 12 - 854
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with former Chief Trainer and handler for the LAPD's K9 Unit Doug Roller. Topics discussed: Getting heavy into falconry; a calling to work with animals; joining the police department; what an apprehension dog is; desirable dog characteristics; prey drive; running into a friendly; smelling fear; bite ratio; when dogs pay the price; buying a protection dog; training tips; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Osceola, Native American Slavery, and The Seminole Wars | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 832 - 12 - 832
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with author Jamie Holmes, Randall Williams, Brody Henderson, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: Jamie's new book, The Free and the Dead: The Untold Story of the Black Seminole Chief, the Indigenous Rebel, and America's Forgotten War is out; deep archival research; the evidence base and when the notes section of the book is almost as long as the book itself; the complexity of stories about the Seminole Wars; turning what you know on its head; the environment of interior Florida; what enslavement meant to the tribes; who were the black Seminole people?; the relationship between Osceola and Abraham; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Clay's Utah Mountain Lion Hunt | "12 in '26" Ep. 855 - 12 - 855
programme.desc: Clay Newcomb answers your questions and breaks down his Utah mountain lion hunt captured in MeatEater's brand new "12 in '26" film series. He hunts with mules and hounds in the mountains, testing his fortitude in some seriously steep and rugged terrain.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Grizz Attack, Mountain Lions Rebound, and a $44K Walleye | The News Show Ep. 875 - 12 - 875
programme.desc: Steven Rinella and the MeatEater crew discuss: Smokejumper Sam Forstag running for Congress in Montana; people getting weird about waterfowl in North Carolina; grizzly attacks at National Parks; spearfishing in Michigan; public land transfers in Alaska; a $44K walleye in Iowa; mountain lion populations rebounding; and more. programme.desc: Steven Rinella has hunted this area before, but he feels he's just scratched the surface exploring the surrounding country. programme.title: MeatEater - Burger Extravaganza Cooking Special

programme.title: MeatEater - Welcome to the Jungle: Adventures in Bolivia Part 1

In this three-part series, he travels deep into the Amazon jungle to hunt with and learn from the locals there. Not only will this be one heck of a hunting adventure, it will be a mind-opening, life-changing event. From bowfishing to hunting in the jungle at night, you never know what the evening's menu will bring.

programme.title: MeatEater - The Coldest Hunt: Nunivak Island Muskox

Steve has always regretted passing up an opportunity to hunt Muskox but with another tag in his pocket, nothing will stop this adventure. We learn about the native history and culture of Nunivak Island's as Steve tries to stay warm while chasing Muskox 30 miles offshore in the Bering Sea.

programme.title: MeatEater - Gobbling: California Turkeys

Steve gives Joe and Bryan the A to Z on hunting, butchering, and cooking the wild turkey. Steve caps off the introductory lesson by preparing his favorite turkey recipe: Schnitzel.

programme.title: Edith's 50Th Birthday-Part 1
programme.desc: Before Edith arrives home, Gloria and Mike teaches Archie the plan for Edith 50th birthday surprise party which will be taken at 6 o'clock at the Stivics house. Edith comes back home while Archie and the Stivics leave to decorate the house for the party. A sudden knock at the door reveals a cop. Edith welcomes the policeman inside the house who claims that there's a rapist in town but he slips out that it's him. Edith is held at gunpoint and pushed on the couch. The rapist slowly strips Edith! Before it can go any longer, the phone rings. The rapist orders Edith to get rid of the caller as soon as possible. When she does, Archie knocks at the door, wondering why the hell the door is locked. The rapist hides himself in the closet and once again orders Edith to get rid of Archie. She does as quickly as possible. Still stranded in the house with the armed man, they suddenly smell something burning. It was the cake which Edith previously started to bake. They rush to the oven where the room is just smoke. When she it pulls, she tosses the hot cake in the rapist's face and rushes outside the kitchen door, but he stops her. She knees him in the groin and exits as soon as possible out of the front door and interupts the party, running into Archie's arms.

programme.title: Edith's 50Th Birthday-Part 2
programme.desc: When Edith tells the story to the family in tears, Gloria and Mike believe she should report to the police while Archie fears Edith will be the one going to jail. Two weeks later, Edith is still ironing sheets for no reason and keeps running upstairs when someone knocks on the door. Gloria tells her dad to give her some TLC (Tender Loving Care). But while he does so, Gloria gets a call from the policemen asking her to identify the rapist. Edith is afraid, but with convincing, Archie takes Edith to the police station.

Gloria asserts that this is because Mike has had the chance to go to college and use his skills, while she hasn't had the chance yet, bringing up the fact that Mike promised her three years ago that chance. programme.title: Runaway Country with Alex Wagner (Trump’s Red State Sabotage)
programme.desc: Has Trump created Farmageddon? Rising fuel and fertilizer costs due to the war with Iran, tariffs on goods because of the trade war with Canada, and a Farm Bill stuck in Congress have created a perfect storm of pain for American farmers. This week Alex speaks to 5th generation Iowa farmer Joshua Manske, to get a real accounting of how the President’s red state agricultural base is feeling. Then she breaks down the big picture implications for Republicans ahead of the midterms with Brian Beutler, founder and author of the Substack newsletter Off Message, and the cohost of the Politix podcast.

programme.title: Strict Scrutiny (We Need To Talk About Court Expansion)
programme.desc: How do you solve a problem like SCOTUS? Kate kicks off our Hot Supreme Court Reform September series with the New York Times’ Jamelle Bouie. They dig into the ins and outs of expanding the Court: what the process could look like, the argument for making the entire federal judiciary bigger, and how to avoid an FDR-style fail.

programme.title: What a Day (No One Can Escape The Time Tax)
programme.desc: Here at What A Day, we’re keeping an eye on the midterms — which are likely to hinge on which party can tackle the skyrocketing cost of living. On today’s show, Jane speaks with The Atlantic’s Annie Lowrey about why it's so damn expensive and complicated to be low-income in America.

programme.title: Pod Save America (Republicans Suddenly Have Plans Next Week)
programme.desc: Dozens of Republican lawmakers tell the press that they won't be attending Trump's midterm convention next week, citing a variety of unconvincing excuses, but the president seems unfazed by his party's lack of enthusiasm for more Trump, announcing Trump midterm ads, Trump coins, and the possibility he may rename the Strait of Hormuz to the Trump Strait. Dan and Jon preview the pity party and then react to Ed Markey's primary win over Seth Moulton, Kamala Harris brushing off red-state Democrats refusing her support, and the Democrats' new line of attack against the GOP — tying the construction of data centers to a tax provision in the Big Beautiful Bill. Then journalist Jasper Nathaniel stops by the studio to talk to Tommy about his reporting on violence in the West Bank.
